column4: What are the ids and names of all countries that either have more than 3 car makers or produce fiat model ?
column5: select t1.countryid ,  t1.countryname from countries as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.countryid  =  t2.country group by t1.countryid having count(*)  >  3 union select t1.countryid ,  t1.countryname from countries as t1 join car_makers as t2 on t1.countryid  =  t2.country join model_list as t3 on t2.id  =  t3.maker where t3.model  =  'fiat';
column6: SELECT T1.CountryName ,  T2.FullName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country WHERE T2.FullName  =  "Fiat" UNION SELECT T1.CountryName ,  T2.FullName FROM countries AS T1 JOIN car_makers AS T2 ON T1.CountryId  =  T2.Country GROUP BY T1.CountryName HAVING count(*)  >  3
